maidbuilder.configuration.title: Maid Builder Settings
maidbuilder.configuration.readonly.no_wo: Open a world to change its server settings.
maidbuilder.configuration.readonly.remot: Server settings can only be changed here in single player (edit serverconfig/maidbuilder-server.toml on the server).
maidbuilder.configuration.schematics.too: Limits for loading, uploading, pasting and capturing schematics.
maidbuilder.configuration.placeReach.too: How far (in blocks) a maid can place blocks from.
maidbuilder.configuration.placeFluids.to: Whether water/lava source blocks and waterlogged states from schematics are built.
maidbuilder.configuration.maxAttempts.to: How many times a maid retries a block (unreachable / cannot survive) before leaving it to the player.
maidbuilder.configuration.maxScanPerSear: Maximum build steps inspected each time a maid looks for her next block. Higher finds buildable blocks more often but costs more.
maidbuilder.configuration.ownerRangeWith: When a builder maid is not in home mode, she only builds blocks this close to her owner.
maidbuilder.configuration.materialSource: How far a builder maid walks to a bound material container.
maidbuilder.configuration.workAreaMargin: When a block is out of reach, a maid looks for a way up only within this many blocks around the structure; beyond it she builds scaffolding.
maidbuilder.configuration.useScaffolding: Whether maids put up scaffolding (from their inventory or material containers) to reach high blocks, and take it down when done.
maidbuilder.configuration.maxScaffoldHei: Tallest scaffolding column a maid builds.
maidbuilder.configuration.maxSchematicVo: Largest schematic volume (x*y*z summed over regions) that will be loaded.
maidbuilder.configuration.maxUploadBytes: Largest schematic file (bytes) a client may upload to the server.
maidbuilder.configuration.maxPasteBlocks: Largest number of blocks /maidbuilder paste places in one go.
maidbuilder.configuration.maxCaptureVolu: Largest area the Blueprint Quill or /maidbuilder save may capture.
maidbuilder.configuration.showHud.toolti: Show placement, progress and missing materials in the top-left corner while holding a Blueprint Wand.
maidbuilder.configuration.ghostOpacity.t: Opacity of the ghost blocks of a placed schematic (1 = solid).
maidbuilder.configuration.previewRenderD: Parts of the preview farther away than this many blocks are not drawn.
maidbuilder.configuration.showWrongBlock: Outline blocks in red where the world has a different block than the schematic.
maidbuilder.configuration.showBoundingBo: Draw a white box around the whole schematic.
With a shader pack (Oculus) active, draw the preview on top of the shaded image so the pack does not light the ghosts like real blocks. Turn off to let the pack shade the preview.
